title: Extract batched represented-matrix norm analysis
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed batched-analysis task only; it does not define aggregation semantics or activate implementation.
objective: Extract norms over ordered batches of represented matrices with explicit matrix axes, batch coordinates, and separate maximum, mean, and root-mean-square reductions.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation, define immutable batch shape, matrix axes, ordering, units, per-matrix norm results, and aggregation records.
Keep per-matrix norm evaluation distinct from maximum, arithmetic mean, root-mean-square, and weighted reductions.
Preserve k-point or real-space coordinate correlation and deterministic serialization order.
completion_criteria: Batch records retain exact coordinate-to-matrix correlation and reject ambiguous axes or shapes.
Each supported aggregation is explicitly named, typed, documented, and independently tested.
Migrated periodic calculations preserve retained numerical outputs.
exclusions: Do not infer weighting, normalization, or convergence policy from array shape.
Do not add lazy distributed arrays, GPU execution, a dependency, or speculative generic tensor utilities.
No protected execution, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
